query: MATCH p = shortestPath((:User)-[:MSSQL_GetAdminTGS|MSSQL_Contains|SCCM_AssignAllPermissions|SCCM_HasClient|SCCM_SameHostAs*1..5]->(c:Computer)) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'PS1-DEV' RETURN p
name: SCCM Site Database Service Account to Client Device
description: Example: find shortest paths of up to five SQL and SCCM relationships from user accounts to a chosen computer. Replace 'PS1-DEV' in the query with the name of the computer you want to investigate. The name filter matches any computer name containing that text.
